# Wischos Gift

> Wischos Gift is a B2B trading company specialising in custom engraved metal corporate gift sets for business buyers worldwide. We source from established Chinese factories and handle everything from product selection to branded packaging and worldwide delivery. MOQ starts at 100 sets.

## About

- [About Wischos Gift](https://wischosgift.com/about): Company background, sourcing network, and our approach to corporate gifting.
- [How It Works](https://wischosgift.com/how-it-works): End-to-end process from first inquiry to delivery — samples, lead times (25–35 days), payment terms.
- [FAQ](https://wischosgift.com/faq): MOQ, lead times, branding options, packaging, and payment questions answered.
- [Contact](https://wischosgift.com/contact): Submit a sourcing inquiry. We respond within 24 hours.

## Gift Sets

Curated metal gift sets ready for custom branding and packaging. FOB pricing from USD 18–50 per set.

- [All Gift Sets](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets): Full catalog of corporate gift sets.
- [Executive Gift Set](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-005): Premium pen and desk accessory set for VIP and executive gifting.
- [Onboarding Gift Set](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-006): Employee welcome kit — pen, notebook, and drinkware bundle.
- [Everyday EDC Set](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-003): Practical everyday carry tools for staff or client gifting.
- [Desk Essentials Set](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-002): Metal desk accessories for professional office gifting.
- [Titanium Premium Set](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-004): High-end titanium drinkware and tools for premium buyers.
- [Classic Pen Set](https://wischosgift.com/gift-sets/wgs-001): Engraved metal pen collection, a reliable corporate classic.

## Products

- [All Products](https://wischosgift.com/products): 25 metal products across pens, desk accessories, EDC tools, and drinkware.

### Pens (wp-101 to wp-104)
Metal ballpoint and rollerball pens suitable for laser engraving with company logo.

### Desk Accessories (wp-201 to wp-207)
Card holders, letter openers, paperweights, and desktop organisers in stainless steel and aluminium.

### EDC Tools (wp-301 to wp-308)
Titanium and stainless steel everyday carry items — multi-tools, keychains, money clips, and utility knives.

### Drinkware (wp-401 to wp-406)
Pure titanium and stainless steel vacuum insulated bottles and cups. Includes Pure Titanium Capsule Bottle 200ml (wp-406).

## Key Facts

- Products: Custom metal corporate gifts (pens, desk accessories, EDC, drinkware)
- Materials: Stainless steel, aluminium, pure titanium
- Branding: Laser engraving, screen printing, custom packaging
- MOQ: 100 sets (flexible for specific products — contact us)
- Lead time: 25–35 days production + shipping
- Pricing: FOB USD 18–50 per set (price on request)
- Markets served: Australia, EU, Canada, Singapore, UK and worldwide
- Contact: inquiries@wischosgift.com
